question.text: If $\left(1+x-2 x^2\right)^6=1+a_1 x+a_2 x^2+\ldots+a_{12} x^{12}$, then the value of $a_2+a_4+a_6+\ldots+a_{12}$ is

solution.text: $\begin{aligned} & \left(1+x-2 x^2\right)^6=1+a_1 x+a_2 x^2+\ldots+a_{12} x^{12} \\ & x=1 \Rightarrow 0=1+a_1+a_2+\ldots+a_{12} \\ & x=-1 \Rightarrow 64=1-a_1+a_2+\ldots+a_{12} \\ & \text { Adding } 64=2\left(1+a_2+a_4+\ldots+a_{12}\right) \\ & a_2+a_4+\ldots+a_{12}=31\end{aligned}$
